_about: The south-east region (the user’s decision 2 after Stage 3): B910 পৃ. ৬২ names the Karnaphuli «দক্ষিণ পূর্বাঞ্চলের প্রধান নদী», so the region is one group under the book’s wording — the Karnaphuli (two main lines either side of Kaptai Lake, which is not drawn) with the Kasalong and the Halda (Stage 2, batch 5), and the rivers of the region that each reach the sea (Stage 3, batch 6, moved here from their own group): the Feni with its tributary the Muhuri, the Sangu, the Matamuhuri and the Naf. Each river is its own main card and lights its basin. B910 পৃ. ৬৩ gives those four a paragraph headed «সাঙ্গু–ফেনী, নাফ, মাতামুহুরী», with no region name. Left out: the Boalkhali and the Rankhiang (no OSM way carries either name), and the Chingri (no cited source says it is the «চেঙ্গী»).

karnaphuliUpper.identified: Ways 661437161 and 1426189152 from the pinned rivers snapshot (key karnaphuli), tagged «কর্ণফুলী নদী» / Karnafuli River, sharing node 8487775973: from the border in Barkal into Kaptai Lake, where it ends. Upstream, OSM continues as «Khawthlangtuipui» (ways 661437160, 530306794, Mizoram), a Mizo name the user has not yet ruled on; not drawn.

karnaphuli.exempt: Unjoined: the lower reach begins in Kaptai Lake's Kaptai arm, 14.6 km from where the upper reach ends in the lake — over the 12 km a connector may bridge (the user's rule, 2026-09-29). Between them lies only the lake (relation 1626722): no waterway, relation, wikidata tag or name variant carries the stretch (osm-b5/ways.md), so it is left undrawn, with a plain ⓘ line.
karnaphuli.identified: Five ways from the pinned rivers snapshot, every link sharing a node, tagged «কর্ণফুলী নদী» / Karnaphuli River (wikidata Q766956 on 653920402), four of them in relation 15588738: from the Kaptai arm through the dam to the sea. Way 528438966, a braid whose two ends are nodes of 30668856, is not drawn.

kasalong.exempt: Unjoined: its drawn mouth is on Kaptai Lake's northern shore, in Langadu, 17.3 km from the drawn Karnaphuli — over the 12 km a connector may bridge (the user's rule, 2026-09-29) — with only the lake between (ⓘ).
kasalong.identified: OSM way 687541579 (this system's extract), tagged «kachalong River», the spelling of BWDB's name «কাচালং» (EH-4, local name «কাসালং»); the only such name in the area. Not drawn: 661447704 "Sajek River", which in OSM flows into the Tuiliampul.

halda.identified: Ways 257617740 («হালদা নদী» / Halda River, Q2606655) and 651892151 ("Halda River"), sharing node 2631082544 (this system's extract). Its tail is 35 m from the next reach; the link is the unnamed way 651892129, not drawn. Above 91.7203°E, 22.7960°N OSM has only unnamed ways, so the line starts there.

halda2.identified: Five ways tagged Halda River / «হালদা নদী» (Q2606655 on 257618058 and 30667147), every link sharing a node (this system's extract), to the Karnaphuli.

feni.identified: Fifteen ways of OSM relation 11107595 «Feni River», every link sharing a node (this system’s extract), from Tripura along the border to the sea off Feni district, where OSM ends the line 20 m from the coastline. Not drawn: a second «Feni River» way, 1135046745 (14.5 km, Khagrachhari), joined to nothing. Drawn solid: it runs along the border for most of its course, so splitting it at COD-AB’s border would cut it into some eighty alternating pieces; the Naf, the border river with Myanmar, likewise.

entities.review: Length and tributaries are null: the two books disagree (B-GEO «প্রায় ২৭৪ কিলোমিটার» and «কাসালং, হালদা এবং বোয়ালখালী»; B910 «৩২০ কি.মি.» and «কাপ্তাই, হালদা, কাসালাং ও রাঙখিয়াং») — both in ⓘ; BWDB 145 km, bn WP 270/320, Banglapedia 131. Origin: B-GEO «আসামের লুসাই পাহাড়», B910 «লুসাই পাহাড়» (one place); BWDB «ভারতের মিজোরাম প্রদেশের লুসাই পাহাড়» (ⓘ). Entry: BWDB EH-3 (the books are silent; no JRC row); the drawn line begins in Barkal (COD-AB). Distributaries: BWDB «নাই»; Banglapedia "Saylok' and Boalkhali" (ⓘ). Mouth: B910's «চট্টগ্রাম শহরের খুব কাছ দিয়ে», in the cautious form (decision 1); BWDB puts it in Anwara upazila, the south bank, and COD-AB the drawn mouth in Chattogram City Corporation (ⓘ). Other names from bn Wikipedia (rev 8477041): the books and BWDB give none.

Conflicts in ⓘ: the entry (BWDB Matiranga, Khagrachhari; JRC Khagrachhari), the origin (JRC adds Khagrachhari) and the length (JRC 140 km; Banglapedia 115.85, en WP 116 recorded only). BWDB’s mouth, the Sandwip Channel at Musapur (Companiganj), is taken as the same place in other words (ⓘ notes). BWDB’s parts, 108 + 44 km, make 152, not its 153 (recorded only). Other names: MISSING in every source (row absent). Main cards carry no relation row; B910’s «প্রধান নদী» list is recorded only.

entities.review: BWDB EH-7, the only Naf. The book: the border river, its length and its mouth; BWDB: origin (as printed, «পার্বত্যঞ্চল»), entry, the Teknaf bank. Conflicts in ⓘ: the entry (JRC: Ukhia, Cox’s Bazar) and the length (BWDB 62, JRC 63). JRC’s origin is the same hills in other words. Other names: MISSING («নাফ নদ» is bn Wikipedia’s spelling), so the row is absent.
